'''Harold C. Helgeson''' (November 13, 1931 – May 28, 2007) was an American scientist and educator. A pioneering theoretical [[geochemistry|geochemist]], he was a professor at the [[University of California, Berkeley]].<ref name="berkeley">{{cite news|author=Sanders, Robert|title=Geochemist Harold Helgeson has died at 75|date=11 June 2007|newspaper=UC Berkeley News|url=http://www.berkeley.edu/news/media/releases/2007/06/11_helgeson.shtml}}</ref>

==Early life==
Born in [[Minneapolis, Minnesota]], he grew up in [[St. Paul, Minnesota|St. Paul]]. He received a B.S. in geology at [[Michigan State University]] in 1953.  Helgeson went to [[Harvard University]] for graduate school, supervised by [[Robert M. Garrels]]. Helgeson received his Ph.D. in 1962.<ref name="berkeley"/>
